Preserve the CRLF1/CLF-1 and soluble CNTFR-alpha complex context; this is not a binary CLCF1-receptor claim.

Clec2g/Clr-d or Clr-d/x recognition by NKR-P1F/Klrb1f reporters supports qualified-high promotion at the exact receptor-recognition/function layer. Preserve mouse strain-dependent Clr nomenclature, overlapping NKR-P1F/G specificity, and no terminal-TF claim.

CNTF-dependent CNTFR-alpha plus gp130/LIFR receptor-complex signaling, phospho-STAT3, and survival function support qualified-high promotion at the exact composite relay/function layer. Exact CNTN2/axonin-1-L1CAM cis adhesion and neurite-outgrowth/fasciculation function support qualified-high promotion at the adhesion/function layer. Preserve cis, neuronal, and L1-family context; this is not a kinase relay and has no terminal-TF claim.

Cardiotrophin-1-dependent LIFR/gp130 complex signaling, JAK/STAT3 and ERK outputs, and cardiomyocyte hypertrophy/survival support qualified-high promotion at the exact composite receptor-relay layer. Preserve LIFR-gp130 topology and cardiac context; no isolated-subunit or terminal-TF claim.
